_purpose: Answer keys for fresh real-world test clips, written BEFORE any model is run on them (journal 13). Each clip is scored once.

clips.author: Richard Goodrow
clips.how_key_was_made: Description says 'BOOK. B-O-O-K. ...'; confirmed by eye at 0.1 s steps: B 2.1-2.6 s, O-O 2.7-2.9 s (brief, one hold), K 3.0-3.5 s.

clips.author: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service
clips.how_key_was_made: Burned-in caption 'What is Campylobacter?'; read at full frame rate: C 25.90, A/M 26.03-26.27 (too fast to separate), P 26.30, Y 26.50, L 26.70, O 26.83, B 27.00, A 27.20, C 27.33, T/E 27.50-27.70, R 27.77-28.10. ~6 letters/s.

clips.author: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service
clips.how_key_was_made: Caption 'Campylobacter bacteria is...'; read at full frame rate: B 29.13, A, C, T, E, R ~30.0, I ~30.1, A 30.30-30.77; the V at 30.84 is the next sign.
